name: 00_current
description: Current build/runtime settings. This is the baseline that should reproduce the current 15 FPS class behavior.

name: 01_no_readback
description: Disable CPU/GPU readback to test pipeline stalls from CopyResource/Map/readback-dependent recovery.

name: 02_no_self_collision
description: Disable self collision and grid self collision to isolate broadphase/solve cost.

name: 03_low_solver
description: Reduce solver iterations to 3 to isolate solver iteration cost.

name: 04_no_debug_draw
description: Disable debug lines, guide/follower skeleton, collider debug, floor guide, and related overlay draw paths.

name: 05_render_light
description: Switch to lighter render/display settings to isolate hair draw/overdraw/geometry-shader cost.

name: 06_simulation_light
description: Minimal simulation stress setting: low iterations, no self collision, no readback. Used to estimate the draw-heavy lower bound.
